title: Semaphores
body:
A semaphore is a non-negative [[Integer]] counter.
[[global variable]] that represents the number of [[Locks]] that are available.
Also is associated with a [[Wait Queue]].
**Acquire lock**
If the semaphore is 0, then you go into a [[Waiting state]] 

**Release lock**
Increment counter *and* signal the waiting thread (if any).

[[POSIX]] standard provides functions to implement this
